name: AccessGrid
summary: API for issuing and managing NFC access passes in Apple and Google Wallet.
description: REST API that issues HID Seos, MIFARE DESFire and SmartTap credentials into Apple and Google Wallet, with HMAC-signed requests and SDKs in 8 languages. Ships with API docs, NFC reader guides, case studies and per-use-case pricing for employee badges, hotel keys and multi-family buildings.
contains: API to issue, update, suspend and delete mobile wallet access passes
SDKs for 8 languages (npm, pip, gem, go, .NET, Maven, Composer, Hex)
supports HID Seos and MIFARE DESFire EV2
docs, guides and a bit-format matcher tool
pricing: card template fee from $49/mo plus per-pass fees
